listing.name: Ridge Racer 6 (Ridge Racer 6 Recomp)
listing.summary: Attach an independently permitted, prepared Ridge Racer 6 Windows native game with its exact USA executable and explicit prepared game folder. Preserve the actual Documents data root; the official asset’s internal TestBuild-09 folder label differs from its 0.1.5 release tag.

steps.title: Prepare the precise supported original upstream
steps.instruction: Use a complete player/components you are independently permitted to use, with your own Xbox 360 Ridge Racer 6 USA original, title 4E4D07D3. The selected source pins default.xex SHA256 39D3C0004EC62AEB0FE3E7E1889CF25D98FBD27987B6BC6B5FF30A56FFBA6C00. Finish the upstream launcher’s ISO/extracted-game preparation and settings before attachment, keeping the independent original and complete game/ data. A matching title ID alone does not qualify another revision, region or update. No ISO, extractor, helper, compiler or game is obtained or executed here.

steps.title: Keep the actual complete Windows package
steps.instruction: The inspected official v0.1.5 RidgeRacer6-PC-v0.1.5.zip contains AMD64 RR6 Launcher.exe and bin/rr6_recomp.exe with matching runtime/GPU libraries. Its internal root is RidgeRacer6-PC-TestBuild-09; use the files actually present rather than inventing a renamed layout from the tag. Keep the full package and its bin/rr6_recomp.toml, game/ and notices. Separate Linux test releases and historical antivirus reports do not establish this Windows artifact’s runtime or safety.

steps.title: Attach the native fallback command after preparation
steps.instruction: Select bin/rr6_recomp.exe, use the complete extracted package root as working directory, and supply --game_data_root with the quoted absolute path to its already prepared game folder, plus --gpu_plugin=xenos and --log_file with the quoted absolute path to this installation’s existing logs/run.log. Use your actual paths, not literal placeholders. This is the selected source’s normal native command and documented no-launcher fallback, with preparation already finished; do not attach the BAT, which starts a child and exits. Review the intent and request Play separately. Diagnostics, DLC import and missing-game repair are separate upstream operations.

steps.title: Preserve the actual Documents root
steps.instruction: Keep the real Windows Documents/rr6_recomp directory, including profile/content trees, saves, achievements and caches, plus bin/rr6_recomp.toml, launcher preferences, logs, game/ and original images. Documents can be redirected. The selected launcher source says a TOML user_data_root line does not change this runtime default; an existing explicit CLI user-data override does, so preserve whichever root the player actually used. Do not assume bin/ or the program root holds saves, merge other revisions, or follow cleanup instructions on another install’s thumbnails/caches. This guide performs no import, backup, restore, migration or deletion.

steps.title: Maintain the complete external unit
steps.instruction: Retain own-code BSD-3-Clause, the exact ReXGlue fork/Xenia and SDL/renderer/component notices; their terms do not license the original Bandai Namco game, DLC or imported saves. The Windows launcher owns setup and optional content; current online modes are unavailable. Quit the actual game normally before upstream replacement/data changes, keep independent recovery and review/relink changed executable bytes. No native/installed, Linux, gameplay, DLC, real-save or Supported acceptance is asserted. Removing registration preserves external files; managed lifecycle operations remain unavailable.

warnings: Use the actual 0.1.5 package layout and already prepared game paths. Preserve redirected Documents data; the no-launcher BAT is not a wait-through-game executable.
